Table S7. Reference panels against panels built from the GWAS's own individuals

Layout pilot, chromosome 22, 250 kb blocks, replicates 1–20, GWAS mix 50:50. r2 with the true genetic value, paired differences with 95% t intervals. Reference panels are built from the reference individuals, as in the main analysis; discovery-built panels from the individuals the GWAS was simulated on, so they differ from the LD the GWAS carries only by the panel estimator. Discovery-built panels are a diagnostic, not a usable method.

Table S8b. How much LD each layout and panel misses

Sampler-free, chromosome 22. Between-block share: of the generating LD's squared correlations between SNPs within 3 Mb, the percentage between blocks, which block-diagonal LD discards (with 1/n sampling noise removed). Within-block error: the panel's squared off-diagonal error within blocks against the generating LD, as a percentage of the generating LD's own off-diagonal sum of squares. Values for 250 kb, 1 Mb and EUR cut points.
